scope: Quiet single-browser representative real-speed source autoplay. Page rAF callback intervals and 20-second cumulative native renderCount observations are separate. GPU submission counters do not prove screen presentation or GPU completion. No screenshots during measurement, private React access, renderer wrapping, source/clock/pixel changes, throttling or forced GC.

cases.notes: One 20s representative interval; not a whole-scroll or cross-device benchmark.

environment.gpu: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti (0x00002C05) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

derivedPostTarget.source: Calculated from current sourceTargetSize formula and actual CSS gate/DPR; not a private render-target readback.

measurement.counterLimit: Counter is cumulative actual completed CPU submission paths; DOM refresh is nominally throttled to100ms. Fresh attribute-observation boundaries are used; diagnostic gaps are not per-native-frame intervals. ±200ms window sensitivity is shown, not a guarantee against arbitrary long-task scheduling. This does not measure monitor presentation or GPU completion.
measurement.pageHeapLimit: Chromium performance.memory is an estimate of JavaScript heap, not CPU process RSS or VRAM.

cdpHeap.limit: CDP V8 JSHeapUsedSize endpoints. No forced GC; not retained-memory or GPU-memory proof.
